duration: Two weeks proposed per sprint; dates unset until kickoff
scope: Local planning only; no live board write, training, integration or release implied

items.title: Review the owner baseline and existing delivery boundary
items.acceptance_criteria: Preserve actual owner feedback separately from analyst judgments; reference the existing result without copying private text into public planning. Inventory uncommitted Sprint 7 and pending Sprint 6 delivery scope. Define a bounded feedback flow, representative development cases and before/after usefulness criteria before code changes.

items.title: Give feedback and review a revised answer
items.acceptance_criteria: Result-level English feedback control; distinguish fact corrections from preferences. Explicit revision action, original/revision lineage, attributable inputs, safe reload and duplicate handling. No implicit approval, contact, training or permanent memory. Define private retention/withdrawal before storage; verify backend and desktop/mobile flow and obtain owner usefulness review.

items.title: Research published learning methods for our errors
items.acceptance_criteria: At most five primary pages/candidates per read-only run, generic queries and brief conclusions. Compare OpenAI example-based optimization, Anthropic published critique/preference methods and local open-model methods against retrieval and workflow changes. State proprietary-method gaps, current-service limits, licenses/dependencies unknown until checked, and applicability limits. No clone/install/cloud inference/training.

items.title: Assess security findings and compatible remediation
items.acceptance_criteria: Recheck four Chroma findings and MCP GHSA-84m7-p3x7-pcfv, current advisories and installed constraints. Document actual exposure evidence and supported options. Do not suppress findings, infer safety from a code grep or force incompatible upgrades. Implement only scoped compatible repairs with relevant checks; retain unresolved release blockers.

items.title: Reuse only reviewed relevant lessons
items.acceptance_criteria: Explicitly propose a lesson for owner review; separate preferences from dated project facts and limit scope. Show which approved lessons were retrieved. Support withdrawal/expiry and conflicts without rewriting history or changing authority. Define retention and versioning before storage. Test no matching lesson, irrelevant lesson, revoked lesson and a correction used on a different task. Retrieval is not weight training.

items.title: Preserve known facts and decision-changing unknowns
items.acceptance_criteria: Cover F01-04/F11 with frozen development variants: unknown/recent/silent contact, supplied product detail, eligibility, current tool state and budget. Do not infer interest from silence or make known facts unknown. A pivotal unknown has consequential alternative answers; citations support the specific claim. Cross-section reasoning, plans and drafts share the same facts. Report quality failures separately from valid schema.

items.title: Build evaluation and reviewed-example foundations
items.acceptance_criteria: Separate development, validation and unused final assessment cases with provenance; never tune against final cases without promoting them. Include applicable Reinstatly regression plus new unrelated tasks, no-feedback baseline, feedback-on and irrelevant-feedback comparisons. Record input/model/settings, first attempts, errors, latency, independent human judgments and failures. Approved corrected examples/preference pairs have privacy and retention controls, no automatic training exports.

items.title: Assess alternatives critique and synthesis
items.acceptance_criteria: Carry BE-60/F05-08/F10: compare independent first proposals with later attributed critique under bounded calls. Do not invent strengths/objections or force diversity. Explain convergence when warranted, preserve meaningful disagreement and evaluate proposal selection against evidence rather than CEO title. Use frozen comparisons; rejected prototypes stay isolated.

items.title: Compare model and workflow choices on usefulness
items.acceptance_criteria: Compare existing permitted installed local models with the same source snapshots, tasks and rubric; report correctness, usefulness, errors and latency separately. Freeze candidates/settings before final assessment. No default change based only on JSON validity or known-case improvement; no new download/cloud inference without authorization. A no-change recommendation is valid.

items.title: Decide whether a local training pilot is justified
items.acceptance_criteria: Assess reviewed dataset sufficiency/diversity, existing model/adaptor licenses, local hardware/memory, runtime, retention/deletion limits of weight training, evaluation and rollback. Compare retrieval, corrected-example training and preference training to baseline. Produce a concrete go/no-go pilot proposal with resource limits. No guaranteed frontier-model equivalence or pilot execution implied.

items.title: Present one coherent answer and usable feedback history
items.acceptance_criteria: Resolve competing application/model effort estimates and unclear authority of recommendations. Show one clearly attributed primary answer and concise rationale, retain disagreement and full details. Test short requests, missing context, working/outage state, silent/recent/no lead and constrained time. Validate owner navigation/readability and usefulness; do not count application-authored steps as model reasoning.

items.title: Prepare coherent integration and operational review
items.acceptance_criteria: Reconcile pending Sprint 6/7 and later changes into reviewable delivery scope; preserve existing files/credentials/company data. Verify request/revision replay, interruption, storage/retention, normal launcher and affected operational/clipboard behavior with suitable isolation and owner checks. Verify Git/PR state. Prepare review evidence; no push/merge or Done without separate authorization and actual integration.

items.title: Run the broad audit after four sprints
items.acceptance_criteria: Audit the actual frozen implementation and integration across agents/API/database/dashboard/executor/worker/privacy/approvals/CI/dependencies and recovery using disposable data. Preserve failed evidence; report exact source scope, counts/skips, security findings and model-quality limits. Recheck affected boundaries sooner during each sprint; this audit does not retroactively clear failures or authorize release.

items.title: Review the cycle and plan the next four sprints
items.acceptance_criteria: Compare intended versus delivered outcomes, owner usefulness and unresolved failures without inventing time/velocity or acceptance. Record accepted scope, actual authorized integration and carryover separately. Review whether feedback/learning improved unseen tasks. Select next-cycle goals; do not create endless follow-on training work from a failed experiment.
